Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 2 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 \\ 5 & 3\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 2 & 5\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(0\cdot 3-3\cdot 5)i-(1\cdot 3-2\cdot 3)j+(1\cdot 5-2\cdot 0)k \\  & =(0-15)i-(3-6)j+(5-0)k \\  & =⟨-15,3,5⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
